title: A pinned --tier is validated at first dispatch, not at run start
body:
When Options.Tier is set, the reconciler skips its construction-time pre-resolution loop and resolves the pinned tier lazily at the first dispatch (profileForTier), and CheckRouting — the doctor/CI start check — has no pin dimension at all. A run pinning a tier that cannot route (balanced on any substrate, as of 7ml) therefore starts and stops at its first dispatch instead of refusing at start, the way the on-demand-jobs check refuses. Fail-loud, not fail-wrong, so it breaks no done item; but the start-time refusal is the pattern this repository already prefers for routing defects.
evidence: internal/reconcile/reconcile.go:1533-1566 (the pre-resolution loop runs only when opts.Tier == ""), internal/reconcile/profiles.go:91-121 (profileForTier resolves lazily), internal/reconcile/profiles.go CheckRouting (no pinned tier)
